info.name: Walmart Cost Management Assortment Recommendations Pre-Generated Reports API

params.name: type
params.description:
Specifies the type of report. Use `type=vendor_item` to fetch the item report from drop ship vendors (DSV). Example(s):
vendor_item

params.name: version
params.description:
Specifies the version used to get the latest version of the item report for drop ship vendors (DSV).

Use `version=2` to access the latest version of the item report for drop ship vendors (DSV).

Example(s):
2

items.docs:
POST /v3/getReport

This request generates the item report for drop ship vendors (DSV). It returns all the information associated with vendor items that are set up on Walmart's platform.
